name: B10-0424/2026 – After recital J – Am 54
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: Ja. whereas both legal and illegal migration over recent decades has served as a catalyst and an enabling environment for the spread of Islam in Europe; whereas the failure of integration policies, coupled with the sheer scale of these migratory flows, has provided fertile ground for Islamic organisations to establish enclaves, recruit followers and exert social control over migrant communities, thereby directly exacerbating the security and cultural challenges faced by Member States;
